answer: Require each identity to escrow a bond and earn it back only after a randomly selected signed forecast matches an independent sensor record. Auditors compare the forecast with the record; a proven duplicate loses its bond. An attacker can mint many names, but must lock capital for every one and risk forfeiture, so fake identities become costly. A public observation from an ocean cliff’s knoll, such as nectar bloom counts, gives peers a checkable reference.
